hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */index.html|index.html) out=$(python3 "$(dirname "$f")/.claude/hooks/check_index_js.py" "$f" 2>&1); if [ -n "$out" ]; then printf '{"decision":"block","reason":%s}' "$(printf '%s' "$out" | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.dumps(sys.stdin.read()))')"; fi;; esac; }
